releases.name: v0.1.2 — Round-12 hardening: RPC contract, file IO and GUI flow fixes
releases.body:
## What's fixed in 0.1.2

Round-12 review hardening, guarded by 43 new regression tests (307 → 350, all green).

**Server**
- `create` RPC now declares the `invalid_format` contract error — malformed matrix/color/steps/model inputs no longer surface as HTTP 500
- Read-path project directory matching is case-insensitive, consistent with the write whitelist
- A failed `unlink` after the atomic link placement rolls back the placeholder instead of leaving a half-moved file behind
- Atomic writes short-retry on Windows `EPERM`/`EBUSY` rename races
- Project-root derivation no longer mis-slices paths containing case-expanding characters
- `EISDIR`/`EACCES` on read/migratePreview map to declared contract errors instead of 500
- Fallback for volumes without hard-link support (exFAT/FAT32): exclusive create via `wx`, exclusive move via `COPYFILE_EXCL`
- V1 `model` + `variant` merge results are validated before being written to disk
- Map-form `permissions` in hand-written files are expanded into rules instead of being silently dropped on save

**GUI**
- The migration preview dialog can no longer be double-opened by rapid clicking
- Saves/renames from the editor no longer trigger a misleading "Disk changed" toast
- The list keeps its rows during refetch (no more flashing loader after every write)
- A stale error view is no longer shown while another scope is loading
- Row busy state survives list refetches (prevents accidental double `setDisabled`)
- The model picker is single-open, and error rendering is exclusive of the empty state
- Invalid `color` / `model` values are sanitized on load instead of failing every save
- Renaming with unsaved edits now asks for confirmation before closing the editor

**Docs**
- Both READMEs link the contributing guides and document two known limitations

> npm 0.1.1 (published without a tag or release) is included by ancestry; the fixes above are relative to it.

**Install:** `npm install opencode-subagent-studio` — requires OpenCode Desktop 2.2.5+ (verified on 2.2.6).

**安装（中文）：** 在 `opencode.jsonc` 的 `plugins` 数组中写包名即可，或在插件目录安装。中文说明见 [README_zh-CN.md](https://github.com/VicChenBike/opencode-subagent-studio/blob/main/README_zh-CN.md)。

releases.name: v0.1.0 — First public release
releases.body:
First public release of **opencode-subagent-studio** — manage OpenCode V2 subagents from the OpenCode Desktop settings.

## Highlights

- Settings page for user-level and project-level subagent scopes: search, hidden/disabled badges, built-in \`general\` / \`explore\` model overrides
- Editor with model + reasoning-effort picker, three-state permission matrix (allow / ask / deny), colour presets, max steps and hidden flag
- Whole-file V1 → V2 migration with a side-by-side preview — comments, key order and unknown fields are preserved
- Live sync for user-level agent directories; save-conflict detection (reload / overwrite with backup) and atomic writes
- Interface in 11 languages (en, zh, fr, es, br, ru, ar, de, ja, hi, ko); 290 unit tests; MIT licensed

## Install

Published on npm — add the package name to \`plugins\` in \`opencode.jsonc\` and fully restart the desktop app:

\`\`\`jsonc
{
  "plugins": ["opencode-subagent-studio"]
}
\`\`\`

Or install from source: clone the repo into \`~/.config/opencode/plugins/\`, run \`npm install && npm run build\`, and point \`plugins\` at the directory. See the [README](https://github.com/VicChenBike/opencode-subagent-studio#readme) for full instructions.

## Compatibility

Built against OpenCode Desktop 2.2.5; verified compatible with 2.2.6. The host plugin API is experimental upstream, so newer desktop releases may require a plugin update.
